description: Apply a keyline to the explicit elementId and areaId. Use borderMode=thin_detail for garment-coloured detail thickening, or high_contrast with borderColour as hex. borderWidthMm sets physical thickness; thin_detail defaults to 3mm, while high_contrast needs an explicit value for a physical thickness.

options.description: Existing arguments; advanced fields/aliases remain accepted. Supplied design patches can overwrite session content; preview/rendering can fetch public image URLs in those designs. Catalogue/session results include the full designArgumentSchema.

borderColour.description: Hex colour for high_contrast, for example #ffffff; colour names are not supported.

borderMode.description: thin_detail uses the garment colour; high_contrast accepts an explicit borderColour.

borderWidthMm.description: Physical keyline thickness in millimetres. thin_detail defaults to 3; set explicitly for high_contrast.

requestId.description: Generate a UUID for a new action. Reuse it only for retrying/polling that same action and payload. A new user edit needs a new UUID.

sessionToken.description: The private expiring capability returned by start_design_session. Do not publish it.

subject.description: The exact subject returned by start_design_session.

name: add_keyline
title: Add a border or keyline
